title: The Ottoman Empire
text: The Ottoman Empire, founded around 1299, was one of the most powerful and long-lasting dynasties in world history, lasting over 600 years until its dissolution in 1922. At its peak in the 16th and 17th centuries, it controlled much of southeastern Europe, western Asia, and northern Africa. Constantinople (modern Istanbul) fell to Ottoman forces in 1453, ending the Byzantine Empire. The empire was notable for its religious tolerance, advanced legal and administrative systems, and contributions to art, architecture (the Hagia Sophia), and science. The empire's decline accelerated in the 19th century and culminated in its defeat in World War I and subsequent partition.
